High-quality hand-painted realistic game terrain with natural scale hierarchy, neutral diffuse albedo, humid deep greens, olive and sage, muted ochre and red-brown. No river, road, buildings, vehicles, people, text, borders, horizon, perspective, recognizable geography, height shading, fluorescent colour, crushed black, farm carpet, hard shadows, or repeated stamps.
